## Governor Choo Mi-ae Publicly Faults Samsung and SK Hynix for Inadequate Wastewater Reduction Efforts

Multiple Korean media outlets amplifying the same environmental pressure story elevates its political visibility above a single-headline event; sustained coverage suggests this warrants monitoring for formal regulatory or legislative action that could impose costs or constrain fab operations.

- Gyeonggi Governor Choo Mi-ae publicly criticized both Samsung and SK Hynix for what she described as insufficient wastewater reduction at their facilities.
- This is a second Korean outlet covering the same environmental regulatory pressure story reported earlier today.
- Dual-outlet coverage raises the political salience of the issue and increases the probability of formal regulatory follow-through.
- No specific compliance deadlines, penalties, or remediation requirements are cited.
